text:
olivia: heads up — trying to tighten deploy workflow for short change windows. idea: add 'pin-lock' to deploy-bot to atomically pin model+infra and block concurrent deploys.

noah: +1. current pin flow requires manual rollbacks. can we also have a `--auto-unlock` flag after successful rollout?

sam: prototype commands below. deploy-bot supports subcommands now: pin, unpin, lock, unlock, snapshot-notes
```
/deploy pin --release 2026-03-18-rc2 --scope api,ingest
/deploy lock --window 30m --owner @olivia
/deploy snapshot-notes --from main --out release-20260318.md
```

olivia: looks good. what about safety checks? e.g., block if >10% error increase in last 5m

jordan: added `--preflight` hook that runs smoke tests and prometheus queries. example:
```
/deploy pin ... --preflight ./scripts/smoke.sh --preflight-query 'rate(errors[5m]) < 0.1'
```

deploy-bot: preflight scheduled by @olivia (id:1923456890). status: queued

sam: question: how does rollback happen when pin-lock is active?

jordan: rollback flow: `/deploy unpin --force --rollback-to=2026-03-10` will unpin and trigger rollback; added a safety TTL: pins auto-unlock after 2h unless `--persist` is passed.

noah: can we get a template for release notes generation? want to auto include pinned versions, changed routes, canary metrics

sam: added `snapshot-notes` output fields: changes[], rollbacks[], canaryBaseline[]. sample:
```
changes:
 - service: api-front
 - image: gcr/...:20260318
rollbacks:
 - last_success: 20260310
canaryBaseline:
 - p95_latency_ms: 120
```

olivia: ack. let's run an experiment next Thurs in the 3-4pm change window. @eng-releases please review docs PR

jordan: opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/release-scripts/pull/432 :eyes:

sam: :thumbsup:
